data.body:
Pushed Gerrit change 1403 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1403), commit 29c76538f5, from worktree d772-delete-probe-shim off origin/main c3fb869ab5.

Pure deletion of scripts/probe-rebar.sh (7 lines). Evidence that no caller remains, on origin/main:
- .github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml:209 -> 'python scripts/probe_rebar.py </dev/null'
- .github/workflows/test.yml:128 -> same
- tests/unit/test_probe_wired_into_ci.py:45 asserts 'scripts/probe_rebar.py'
- docs/releasing.md:401,405,407 -> 'python scripts/probe_rebar.py'
- .github/workflows/external-integration.yml:265 comment notes the probe is now Python
Checked both semantically (tokensave symbol search surfaced only test_golden_path_job_invokes_probe, which asserts probe_rebar.py) and by string grep over every tracked file, plus Makefile/.pre-commit-config.yaml/pyproject.toml/.github for path-glob references. No shell-script allowlist names it.

AC2 proving command returns empty after deletion:
  git grep -n 'probe-rebar' -- . ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!pyproject.toml' ':!scripts/probe_rebar.py' ':!docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/operator_attested_ac_corpus.jsonl'

Local pre-flight: make lint PASS, make typecheck PASS (432 files), tests/unit/test_probe_wired_into_ci.py 2 passed, tests/scripts 588 passed / 1 skipped both WITH and WITHOUT the deletion (baseline-compared via git stash) -- confirming no behavioral delta. An initial run showed failures only under pytest-randomly ordering; they reproduce on the unmodified tree too and are unrelated.
